maps3d-robolectric-testing/com.google.maps.android.robolectric.maps3d.shadows/ShadowMap3DView

ShadowMap3DView

@Implements(value = Map3DView::class)
open class ShadowMap3DView : ShadowViewGroup

Robolectric shadow for Map3DView.

Intercepts all Map3DView constructors and lifecycle callbacks so Activities and Compose AndroidView hosts can inflate and drive a 3D map cleanly on the JVM without Google Play services. Delivers a shadowed GoogleMap3D instance via getMap3DViewAsync and exposes helpers to trigger scene readiness, steady state, and error callbacks deterministically.
